title: Roads near the test centre

blocks: Expect a mix of residential streets, roundabouts, and faster main roads near a test centre.
Watch for parked cars, narrow industrial estate exits, and sudden speed-limit changes.
Official driving test routes are not published, so practise reading signs and markings early.
Keep calm and follow independent driving directions safely, even if you miss a turn.

scenarios.goal: Drive safely through residential streets, roundabouts, and main roads near the test centre.
Follow the direction signs from Spring Road towards the main road network.

recap: Scan ahead for speed-limit changes when leaving residential or industrial roads.
These practice routes build general confidence and are not official test routes.
